cohort: The study included 47 premature neonates with a median gestational age of 27 weeks and median birth weight of 970g who were treated with colistin.
finding: Acute kidney injury was observed in 17.0% of premature neonates treated with colistin, and electrolyte imbalances, specifically a decrease in mean magnesium levels and an increase in hypomagnesemia and elevated AST, were significantly observed after colistin use.
followup_time: The last observations for side effects were taken around the end of the mean 15.95-day colistin therapy, which began at a median postnatal day of 24.
